implement.action: Implement the assigned behavior within the declared scope.
exit: The intended change and focused regression tests are ready.

validate.action: Run the applicable bounded validation and inspect the results.
exit: Record the actual validation outcome and relevant code revision.

reconcile.action: Drive required review/merge gates, reconcile the effort and select the next authorized action.
exit: Every canonical Plan/Validation item is resolved or explicitly transferred, and the effort is Done.
